budget._note: weekly_tokens: no script can read your plan's quota (ADR 2026-09-13e; wf-spend.sh says so in its own comment). Run /usage in-session, read the weekly number, put it here. On a Team plan it may be pooled across seats — use YOUR share. cycle._note: max_repair_rounds bounds the loop: a finding still unfixed after 2 repair rounds, or one the repair lane disputes, becomes an owner desk item instead of a third round. high_risk_paths get the 3-vote adversarial panel; everything else gets 1 vote; deterministic-checker territory (ARB, tokens, generated) gets none.
